ComputeDriven Edge + Fabric — R0

Executable gates for the R0 architectural claims. See the handoff document for the frozen constraints and budgets; see receipts/ for evidence.

  • cd-core — frozen semantic minimum (no_std, no deps): identities,

explicit locus attachment, evidence-only authority, budgets.

  • cd-wire — v1 frame codec (no_std, no alloc), golden vectors in tests.

  • cd-node — minimal Fabric node: semantic file-backed NodeId, UDP

HELLO/ACK. R0.5 proves the id is unchanged by network events within one running embodiment; restart persistence is NOT among its claims.

  • cd-micro — Micro-Locus probe: freestanding no_std/no_main ELF on an

exactly-64KiB RAM linker map with link-time budget ASSERTs.

Build/verify everything: ./tools/guards.sh (must print ALL GUARDS PASS). Live exchange demo: ./tools/demo_r04.sh

Toolchain pin: rustc/cargo 1.75.0 (Ubuntu 24.04 archive).
